entries.d2694490c7b6d972: The company states that the core foundational technologies underpinning its technology deployment are “materials and formulation,” “design,” “processing processes” and “evaluation and analysis,” with silicone, various plastics and conductive materials as key materials. entries.f86009239aee58ca: In November 2025, the company announced its medium-term management plan, “Shin-Etsu Polymer Global & Growth 2029” (abbreviated as SEP G&G 2029), with the fiscal year ending March 2030 as its final year. As its business strategy, the company has set out the acquisition of new applications and active investment in growth areas, the expansion of sales of proprietary products and productivity improvement in core areas, and the expansion of the overseas sales ratio. In its financial and non-financial strategies, the company states that it will continue focused investment in growth areas, strengthen shareholder returns and enhance its ESG initiatives.
